blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: For efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs), methods of ultra-low-bit backbones reduce weight storage, memory traffic, and linear-layer execution cost, while multi-token prediction (MTP) methods reduce sequential decoding steps by predicting multiple future tokens in parallel. Although complementary, the direct combination of these methods cannot accelerate decoding at comparable quality: masked drafting lacks intermediate token input supplied in next-token training, while wider computation and causal key-value (KV) updates can offset the savings from fewer steps. To address these challenges, we propose BitMTP, an algorithm-system co-design framework for efficient MTP on ultra-low-bit LLM backbones. A joint next-token prediction and MTP objective equips a single model with both autoregressive (AR) generation and block-causal drafting. Confidence-only decoding, speculative-only decoding, and hybrid decoding provide different quality-throughput operating points without using separate draft and verifier models. Accepted-prefix alignment keeps the committed prefix, materialized causal KV boundary, and CUDA Graph replay state consistent for continued generation. BitMTP uses this contract to select width-specialized low-bit execution and reuse captured graphs over shared KV storage. On NVIDIA H20, BitMTP with hybrid decoding achieves five-task mean speedups of 2.2x on BitNet b1.58-2B and 2.1-2.4x on 1.7B-4B Bonsai models at comparable task quality. On RTX 3090 and Jetson Orin, it further achieves up to 2.0x in five-task mean throughput and 3.3x on MBPP+, respectively. These results demonstrate that BitMTP accelerates ultra-low-bit LLM generation across backbones, model sizes, and GPU types. The source code is released at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/BitMTP
blocks.zh: 为了高效部署大型语言模型(LLMs),超低位主干线的方法降低了重量存储,内存流量,线性层执行成本,而多位预测(MTP)方法通过平行预测多个未来符号来减少顺序解码步骤. 这些方法的直接结合虽然是相辅相成的,但无法在相当的质量上加速解码:蒙面的起草缺乏在旁边的训练中提供的中间符号输入,而更广泛的计算和因果键值(KV)更新可以抵消较少步骤带来的节省. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议BitMTP,一个在超低位LLM主干线上高效MTP的算法系统共设计框架. 联合下接预测和中期计划目标为单一模型配备了自动递归生成和块-因果起草两种功能。 唯信任解码,唯投机解码,以及混合解码提供了不同的质量通量操作点,而不使用单独的草稿和验证模型. 接受-前缀对齐保持承诺的前缀,实现的因果KV边界,以及CUDA Graph重播状态一致,以持续生成. BitMTP利用这一合同选择了宽度专用低位执行和重用所捕获的图,而不是共享的KV存储. 在NVIDIA H20上,具有混合解码功能的BitMTP在BitNet b1.58-2B上实现了2.2x的五任务平均速度,在1.7B-4B Bonsai模型上实现了2.1-2.4x,任务质量相当. 在RTX 3090和Jetson Orin上,它在5任务平均吞吐量和在MBPP+上分别进一步达到2.0x. 这些结果表明,BitMTP加速超低位LLM生成跨越骨干,模型大小,以及GPU类型. 源代码发布于https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/BitMTP

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The deployment of large language models (LLMs) is constrained by both model footprint and the serial decoding latency of autoregressive (AR) next-token prediction (NTP) [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . To resolve this limit, ultra-low-bit models such as BitNet b1.58 reduce weight storage, memory traffic, and linear-layer execution cost through ternary weights [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] , while multi-token prediction (MTP) methods target the sequential bottleneck by predicting multiple future tokens in one pass [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] . Despite their complementarity, direct combination of ultra-low-bit models and block-parallel MTP may not accelerate decoding at comparable quality: masked block prediction omits NTP’s intermediate token inputs, calling for adaptation to preserve quality, while wider computation and acceptance-dependent causal key–value (KV) updates can offset the latency savings from fewer sequential decoding steps.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)的部署受到模型脚印和自旋式(AR)下位预测(NTP)[1,2,3]的序列解码间隔的限制. 为了解决这一限制,BitNet b1.58等超低位模型通过三元加权[4,5,6]降低重量存储,内存流量,线性层执行成本,而多位预测(MTP)方法则通过在一次通过中预测多个未来令牌来瞄准顺序瓶颈[7,8,9,10,11,12,13]. 尽管它们具有互补性,但直接结合超低位模型和块平行的MTP可能无法在相当的质量上加速解码:蒙蔽的块预测省略了NTP的中间符号输入,要求调整以保持质量,而更广泛的计算和接受依赖的因果键–值(KV)更新可以抵消顺序解码步骤较少的暂时性节省.

blocks.en: To better illustrate the above-mentioned problem, we apply the block-parallel prediction mechanism [ 10 ] to BitNet b1.58-2B [ 5 ] and name the fine-tuned model ‘Naive BitNet + + MTP’. On NVIDIA H20, we compare its five-task mean quality and decode throughput with the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) AR baseline of BitNet b1.58-2B. The left panel of Figure 1 shows that the naive combination improves throughput on BF16. However, we see in the right panel of Figure 1 that it loses both throughput and quality in the low-bit W2A8 setting (2-bit weights and 8-bit activations), which shows that fewer decoding steps alone cannot ensure faster low-bit generation. More generally, an MTP decoder’s throughput depends on iteration cost and the number of committed tokens. First, a block decoder must execute a wider computation and maintain causal KV states for continued generation. Second, iteration cost is amortized over committed tokens, rather than all predicted tokens. The accepted prefix and decoding policy therefore determine the committed-token count, pending causal KV work, and subsequent replay input. Verifier-based policies additionally require a verification replay. We call the resulting changes in replay inputs, causal KV work, and verifier invocation ‘accepted-prefix dynamics’. Efficiently executing these transitions turns parallel proposals into multi-token speedups on ultra-low-bit LLMs.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地说明上述问题,我们将区块平行预测机制[10]应用于BitNet b1.58-2B [5] , 并命名为“Naive BitNet + + MTP ” 。 在NVIDIA H20上,我们将其五大任务的平均质量和解码吞吐量与BitNet b1.58-2B的监督微调(SFT)AR基线进行比较。 图1的左面板显示,天真的组合提高了BF16上的吞吐量. 然而,我们在图1的右面板中看到,它在低位W2A8设置中会同时失去吞吐量和质量(2位重和8位激活),这表明单靠更少的解码步骤无法确保更快的低位生成. 更一般地说,中期计划编码器的吞吐量取决于重塑成本和承诺的代币数量。 首先,块解码器必须执行更广泛的计算,并保持因果KV状态,以便持续生成. 第二,重迭费用由承付的代币而不是所有预测的代币摊销。 因此,被接受的前缀和解码政策决定了承诺的计数,等待因果 KV 工作,然后重播输入. 基于验证的政策还需要重新进行核查。 我们称由此而来在回放输入、因果 KV 工作以及验证人引用“接受-前缀动态”方面的改变。 高效地执行这些过渡将并行提案转化为超低位LLMs上的多键加速.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Five-task mean generation quality (%) and decode throughput (tokens/s) for BitNet b1.58-2B-SFT AR, Naive BitNet + + MTP, and the proposed BitMTP on NVIDIA H20. The left panel shows the results by using BF16 reference execution, while the right panel uses low-bit W2A8 execution (2-bit weights and 8-bit activations). We see that the naive combination on BF16 improves throughput, but it loses both throughput and quality in the low-bit W2A8 setting. In contrast, our BitMTP substantially increases throughput while retaining task quality comparable to SFT AR.

blocks.en: To achieve faster decoding at comparable quality on ultra-low-bit LLM backbones, we propose BitMTP , an algorithm–system co-design framework. At the training level, a joint NTP + + MTP objective equips the model with mask-conditioned block-causal drafting and an AR path. At the decoding level, confidence-only decoding, speculative-only decoding, and hybrid decoding provide different quality–throughput operating points without using separate draft and verifier models. At the runtime level, three mechanisms are used to reduce block computation and state-update costs. M1 specializes packed low-bit execution by replay width and uses role-dependent output projections. M2 uses a finite-state CUDA Graph atlas to replay reachable pending-prefix states over shared KV storage. M3 prepares verifier inputs before the host branch decision in hybrid decoding. Accepted-prefix alignment keeps the committed prefix, materialized causal KV boundary, and CUDA Graph replay state consistent across decoding and runtime. This supports captured-graph reuse over shared KV history as accepted prefixes change, reducing overhead of multi-token decoding. As shown in Figure 1 , BitMTP achieves substantially higher decode throughput at comparable task quality to the SFT AR baseline. Our main contributions are summarized below: • First end-to-end MTP framework for ultra-low-bit LLMs. To our knowledge, BitMTP is the first framework to co-design MTP training, decoding, and runtime execution for ultra-low-bit LLMs. Accepted-prefix alignment coordinates decoding decisions with causal KV materialization and graph replay. Captured graphs reuse shared causal KV history across changing accepted prefixes, reducing full-history copying overhead and supporting faster low-bit multi-token decoding. • Joint training and flexible decoding. BitMTP combines a joint NTP + + MTP objective with confidence-only decoding, speculative-only decoding, and hybrid decoding. It thereby supports an AR path and mask-conditioned block-causal drafting without a separate draft–verifier pair. The three decoding policies provide different quality–throughput operating points. • Replayable runtime for dynamic MTP states. BitMTP introduces a three-part runtime that reconciles accepted-prefix-dependent execution with fixed-shape CUDA Graph replay. Width-specialized low-bit execution, shared-KV graph replay, and hoisted verifier preparation control the kernel, memory, and scheduling overheads exposed by MTP on low-bit LLM backbones. • Validation across models and hardware types. Experiments on BitNet b1.58-2B and Bonsai models from 1.7B to 4B demonstrate that BitMTP achieves mean decode speedups of up to 2.4 × 2.4\times on H20 and 2.0 × 2.0\times on RTX 3090. It also reaches a 3.3 × 3.3\times MBPP+ speedup on Jetson Orin, demonstrating generalization across backbones, scales, and GPU types.
blocks.zh: 为了在超低位LLM主干线上以可比质量实现更快的解码,我们提出BitMTP,一种算法–系统共设计框架. 在培训方面,一个联合NTP + + MTP目标为模型配备了带口罩的块-因果起草和AR路径. 在解码层面,仅信任解码,投机解码,混合解码提供不同的质量-通量操作点,而不使用单独的草稿和验证模型. 在运行时间层面,采用三种机制来降低块计算和状态更新成本. M1通过重播宽度专门进行打包的低位执行,并使用依赖角色的输出预测. M2使用有限状态的 CUDA Graph 地图集在共享的 KV 存储上重放可到达的待补状态. M3在混合解码中,在主机分支决定前准备校验输入. 接受-前缀对齐保持承诺的前缀,实现因果KV边界,CUDA Graph重播状态在解码和运行时间之间保持一致. 这支持在共享的 KV 历史中作为被接受的前缀更改来进行抓图再利用,减少多托肯解码的间接费用. 如图1所示,BitMTP在任务质量与SFT AR基线相当的情况下,实现了高得多的解码吞吐量. 我们的主要贡献概述如下: • 超低位LLMs的第一个端到端的MTP框架. 据我们所知,BitMTP是第一个为超低位LLMs共同设计MTP训练,解码和运行时间执行的框架. 接受-前缀对齐以因果 KV 实现化和图表重播来协调解码决定. 抓取的图可以重复使用共享的因子KV历史,跨越更改被接受的前缀,减少全史复制的间接费用,支持更快的低位多托肯解码. • 联合培训和灵活解码。 BitMTP结合了一个联合NTP++MTP目标,与只有信任的解码,只有投机的解码,以及混合解码. 因此,它支持AR路径和口罩式的块状-因果起草,而不另设一对草稿-核查者。 三种编码政策提供不同的质量-通量操作点。 • 动态中期计划状态的可重复运行时间。 BitMTP引入了三段运行时间,将接受的-前缀依赖执行与固定形状的CUDA Graph重播进行调和. Width专业的低位执行,共享-KV图重播,以及上架的核查器准备控制了MTP在低位LLM主干线上暴露的内核,内存,和调度管理费. • 跨模型和硬件类型的验证。 BitNet b1.58-2B和Bonsai型号从1.7B到4B的实验表明,BitMTP实现平均解码速度在H20上达到2.4×2.4\时,RTX3090上达到2.0×2.0\时. 它还在Jetson Orin上达到3.3×3.3\times MBPP+速度,显示跨骨干,天平,GPU类型的通用化.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Low-bit LLMs. Low-bit LLMs can be obtained by quantizing a pretrained full-precision model or pretraining directly in the low-bit regime. Post-training quantization applies quantization after full-precision training [ 14 , 15 ] , whereas quantization-aware training incorporates the target quantizer during model optimization [ 16 , 6 ] . For example, Bonsai applies quantization-aware training to pretrained Qwen3 backbones to obtain ternary models [ 17 ] . BitNet and BitNet b1.58 instead use native low-bit pretraining [ 18 , 4 , 5 ] . Although low-bit representations reduce weight storage and linear-layer execution cost, token-by-token AR generation still requires a separate model pass for each output token, limiting further throughput gains. Our BitMTP addresses this sequential bottleneck by predicting blocks and committing variable-length continuations on the low-bit backbone.
blocks.zh: 低位 LLMs. 低位 LLMs可以通过在低位制中对一个预先训练的全精度模型进行量化或者直接进行预训来获得. 训练后量化法在完全精准训练后适用量化法[14,15],而量化-意识训练则在模型优化期间纳入目标量化法[16,6]. 例如,邦赛将量化-意识训练用于预训的Quen3骨干以获得ternary模型[17]. BitNet和BitNet b1.58转而使用本土低位预训[18,4,5]. 虽然低位表示会降低重量存储和线性层执行成本,但逐个符号的AR生成仍然需要每个输出符的单独的模型通过,从而限制了进一步的吞吐量收益. 我们的BitMTP通过预测块和在低位主干上进行可变长度的续作来解决这个顺序瓶颈.

blocks.en:
Parallel drafting and blockwise generation. Recent methods reduce sequential decoding steps through auxiliary heads, learned drafters, or block-parallel prediction [ 19 , 8 , 7 , 11 ] . Medusa adds decoding heads and verifies alternative continuations with tree attention [ 8 ] . EAGLE predicts future hidden states, EAGLE-2 builds context-dependent draft trees, and EAGLE-3 predicts tokens from features fused across target layers [ 7 , 20 , 21 ] . Training approaches include future-summary supervision [ 22 ] , non-adjacent targets [ 23 ] , and self-distillation [ 24 ] . DeepSeek-V3 incorporates MTP during pretraining [ 13 ] . Masked-input adaptation with gated LoRA and consistency losses exposes a pretrained model’s MTP potential [ 12 ] . Other methods reuse target-model components or adapt draft structures and budgets [ 9 , 11 , 25 , 26 , 27 ] . DFlash generates blocks with a target-feature-conditioned diffusion drafter before speculative verification [ 28 ] . Sequential Diffusion Language Models (SDLM) predict masked token blocks and use confidence to commit consecutive prefixes [ 10 ] .
In addition, QSpec [ 29 ] shares 4-bit weights and a KV cache between W4A4 drafting and W4A16 verification. ML-SpecQD [ 30 ] pairs an MXFP4 draft with a BF16 target and recursively accelerates drafting with a smaller model. QuantSpec [ 31 ] combines hierarchical KV quantization with optional 4-bit draft MLP weights. Although these quantized draft–verify methods combine quantization with speculative decoding to reduce drafting and memory costs, sequential proposal dependencies and recurring verification still constrain further acceleration. Our BitMTP combines block-parallel proposals, conditional verification in hybrid decoding, and accepted-prefix-aligned low-bit execution to reduce work per committed token.
blocks.zh:
平行起草和阻断生成. 近期的方法通过辅助头,学习的起草者,或块平行预测来减少顺序解码步骤[19,8,7,11]. 美杜莎增加了解码头,并用树心验证替代续作[8]. EAGLE预测未来隐藏状态,EAGLE-2构建基于上下文的草稿树,EAGLE-3预测从跨越目标层的特性中导出符号[7,20,21]. 培训办法包括未来总结监督[22]、非邻近目标[23]和自我消化[24]。 深搜索- V3 包含 预训期间的中期计划[13]. 加上LORA, 加上一致性损失, 其他方法再利用目标模型组件或调整结构和预算草案[9、11、25、26、27]。 DFlash在进行投机性核查之前,会生成带有目标特性条件扩散起草器的块[28]. 序列扩散语言模型(SDLM)预测蒙面符号块,并使用信心来进行连续前缀[10].
此外,QSpec [29]在W4A4起草和W4A16验证之间共享4位重和一个KV缓存. ML-SpecQD [30] 搭配了带有BF16靶的MXFP4草稿,并用较小的模型递归加速起草. QuantSpec [31] 将分级的KV量化与可选的4位草稿MLP权重结合. 虽然这些量化的草案核查方法将量化与投机解码结合起来,以减少起草和内存成本,但相继提出的依赖性和经常性的核查仍然制约着进一步的加速。 我们的BitMTP结合了块平行建议,在混合解码中有条件的验证,以及被接受的-前缀-对齐低位执行,以减少每个承诺的符号的工作.

blocks.en: Inference runtimes for efficient generation. The CPU inference system of BitNet provides specialized kernels for ternary execution [ 32 ] . GPU systems such as Atom and QServe co-design low-bit quantization and serving optimizations [ 33 , 34 ] . Other work optimizes attention and decode kernels [ 1 , 35 , 36 , 37 ] . KV-cache techniques address allocation, compression, and quantization [ 38 , 39 , 40 , 41 , 42 ] . Serving systems improve request scheduling and execution [ 43 , 44 , 45 , 46 ] . For block generation on an ultra-low-bit LLM, the accepted prefix and verification branch determine causal KV materialization and the next replay input. Kernel, cache, and scheduling optimizations alone do not provide a coordinated end-to-end acceleration path for these transitions. Our proposed BitMTP provides this path through width-specialized packed operators, captured graphs over shared KV storage, and preparation of verifier inputs before the hybrid branch decision.
blocks.zh: 高效生成的推断运行时间. BitNet的CPU推断系统为三元执行提供了专门的内核[32]. Atom和QServe等GPU系统共同设计低位量化和服务优化[33,34]. 其他工作优化了注意力,解码内核[1,35,36,37]. KV-cache技术处理分配、压缩和量化[38、39、40、41、42]。 服务系统改进请求的时间安排和执行[43、44、45、46]。 对于超低位 LLM 上的块生成,被接受的前缀和验证分支决定了因果 KV 的实现和下一次的重播输入. 内核,缓存,以及排程优化本身并不能为这些过渡提供协调的端到端加速路径. 我们提出的BitMTP通过宽度专用的包装操作器提供这一路径,在共享的KV存储器上捕获图表,并在混合分支决定前准备验证器输入.

blocks.en: 3 The BitMTP Framework
blocks.zh: BitMTP 框架

blocks.en: 3.1 Method Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 方法概述

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , BitMTP enables low-bit multi-token generation through coordinated training, decoding, and runtime components. Joint training equips the model with both AR generation and mask-conditioned block-causal drafting. The decoding component uses confidence-only decoding, speculative-only decoding, or hybrid decoding to select the committed prefix. blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en: Models, training, and decoding. We evaluate three ultra-low-bit LLM backbones: BitNet b1.58-2B [ 5 ] , Bonsai-1.7B, and Bonsai-4B [ 17 ] . For each backbone, additional supervised fine-tuning produces the SFT model used as the AR baseline. The SFT and MTP variants use the same processed corpus, with MTP using the joint objective in Eq. 3 . Generation uses greedy decoding. Primary confidence-only decoding and hybrid decoding use τ = 0.9 \tau{=}0.9 . Hybrid decoding uses the model’s AR-causal verifier to determine the accepted prefix when verification is required. Appendix B summarizes the training corpus and reports one-epoch training cost on Bonsai-1.7B.
blocks.zh: 模型,培训和解码。 我们评价三个超低位LLM主干:BitNet b1.58-2B [5],Bonsai-1.7B,以及Bonsai-4B [17]. 对于每个主干线,额外的有监督的微调产生用作AR基线的SFT模型. SFT和MTP的变体使用相同的加工体,MTP使用Eq中的联合目标. 页:1 一代用贪解码. 主置置置信解码和混合解码使用\\=0.9\tau{=}0.9. 混合解码使用模型的AR-causal验证器,在需要验证时确定被接受的前缀. 附 录 B概述了培训大纲,并报告了Bonsai-1.7B的一次性培训费用。

blocks.en: Hardware and low-bit backends. Server, consumer, and edge tests use NVIDIA H20, RTX 3090, and Jetson Orin NX, respectively. The PyTorch/CUDA runtime uses packed W2A8 for decode-stage transformer linear layers, with INT2 weights for BitNet and group-128 ternary weights for Bonsai. H20 enables FP8 draft projections for the fast drafting roles in M1. The FP8 GEMM backend does not support the Ampere GPUs in RTX 3090 and Orin, so these platforms use non-FP8 draft projections. Orin runs under MAXN_SUPER with locked clocks. AR generation and verifier replay use verification-critical projections. Other baseline systems use their released runtimes.
blocks.zh: 硬件和低位后端. 服务器,消费者,和边缘测试分别使用NVIDIA H20,RTX 3090和Jetson Orin NX. PyTorch/CUDA运行时使用包装的W2A8进行解码级变压器线性层,BitNet的INT2重,Bonsai的组-128三重. H20使FP8草案能够预测M1的快速起草作用。 FP8 GEMM后端不支持RTX 3090和Orin中的Ampere GPU,因此这些平台使用非FP8草案预测. 奥林在MAXN下运行_ SUPER有锁定的时钟。 AR生成和验证器重放使用验证关键预测. 其他基准系统使用其释放的运行时间。

blocks.en: Generation benchmarks. The generation suite covers IFEval for instruction following, GSM8K and MATH-500 for reasoning, and HumanEval+ and MBPP+ for code generation. We report strict instruction-following accuracy, exact match for reasoning, and EvalPlus pass@1 for code.

blocks.en: Metrics and model capability evaluation. Decode throughput divides timed output tokens by decode-loop time measured after prefill and request initialization. Task means are unweighted across the five generation benchmarks, and speedups use the matched SFT AR route on the same device and backend. The eleven-task capability evaluation uses lm-eval with full benchmark sets and standard prompts.

blocks.en: Table 1 compares compact BF16 models [ 47 , 48 , 49 ] , quantized and low-bit AR models, and learned draft–verify systems with BitMTP on H20. The Bonsai mean scores remain close to SFT: 47.91 47.91 versus 47.36 47.36 and 63.43 63.43 versus 63.55 63.55 . The compact-model comparisons further place this quality in context. With hybrid decoding, BitMTP–Bonsai-1.7B approaches BF16 Qwen2.5-1.5B’s 49.23 49.23 and exceeds its AWQ variant’s 41.79 41.79 , while BitMTP–Bonsai-4B exceeds Llama-3.2-3B’s 57.41 57.41 and Qwen3-1.7B’s 58.23 58.23 . blocks.en: Increasing D D from 4 4 to 8 8 raises hybrid mean throughput from 722.12 722.12 to 805.57 805.57 tokens/s on BitNet and from 952.18 952.18 to 1110.65 1110.65 on Bonsai-1.7B. Useful progress depends on the committed prefix rather than the proposed width alone. For Bonsai-1.7B hybrid decoding at D = 8 D{=}8 , BitMTP obtains 2.7 × 2.7\times and 3.0 × 3.0\times speedups on HumanEval+ and MBPP+, and a 1.7 × 1.7\times speedup on IFEval. These runs commit approximately 6.7 6.7 and 7.1 7.1 tokens per iteration on the code tasks, versus 4.6 4.6 on IFEval. This pattern is consistent with amortizing block computation and state updates over more committed tokens, connecting workload-dependent acceleration to the execution state managed by BitMTP. With D = 8 D{=}8 hybrid decoding, both Bonsai-1.7B and Bonsai-4B achieve more than twice the five-task mean throughput of their respective SFT baselines while maintaining comparable mean task quality. These results show that BitMTP retains substantial acceleration as the backbone scales from 1.7B to 4B parameters.

In the forced-rejection test reported in Appendix C , each round performs block drafting and verification but commits at most one verifier-origin token, resulting in throughput below AR. In contrast, evaluated Bonsai-1.7B hybrid decoding at D = 8 D{=}8 commits 4.6 4.6 – 7.1 7.1 tokens per iteration across five tasks. Multi-token commitment amortizes block execution and verification. Appendix D quantifies the memory and initialization costs of deploying the full runtime. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Limitation
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和限制

blocks.en: BitMTP enabled efficient multi-token generation on ultra-low-bit LLM backbones through joint NTP + + MTP training, three decoding policies, and accepted-prefix-aligned runtime execution. The runtime combined width-specialized operators, shared-KV graph replay, and verifier scheduling. At D = 8 D{=}8 on H20, hybrid decoding reached five-task mean speedups of 2.2 × 2.2\times on BitNet b1.58-2B and 2.1 2.1 – 2.4 × 2.4\times on 1.7B–4B Bonsai models at comparable task quality. BitMTP reached up to 2.0 × 2.0\times in five-task mean throughput on RTX 3090 and 3.3 × 3.3\times on MBPP+ on Jetson Orin. These results demonstrated effective low-bit multi-token acceleration across ternary backbones, model scales, and GPU types.
blocks.zh: BitMTP通过联合NTP + + MTP培训,三种解码政策,以及接受的-前缀-对齐运行时执行,在超低位LLM主干线上实现了高效的多托肯生成. 运行时间组合宽度-专业操作器,共享-KV图形重播,以及验证器排程. 在H20上的D=8 D{=}8,混合解码在BitNet b1.58-2B和2.1 2.1 – 2.4 – 2.4 – 2.4 – 4B Bonsai模型上达到5任务平均速度2.2×2.2\时,任务质量相当. BitMTP在RTX 3090和Jetson Orin的MBPP+上达到最高2.0×2.0\时的平均吞吐量。 这些结果表明了跨三角骨干、模型尺度和GPU类型的有效低位多键加速。

blocks.en: There are some limitations of BitMTP. First, while BitMTP has been evaluated on 1.7B–4B backbones, its quality–throughput tradeoffs on larger models and longer contexts still need validation. Second, the current runtime relies on CUDA-specific low-bit kernels and CUDA Graphs and cannot run directly on non-CUDA accelerators. We will investigate these problems in further work.
blocks.zh: BitMTP有一些局限性. 首先,虽然BitMTP已经在1.7B–4B主干线上得到了评价,但其质量-通过量对较大模型和较长背景的权衡仍需验证。 其次,目前的运行时间依赖于CUDA特定的低位内核和CUDA Graphs,不能直接运行在非CUDA加速器上. 我们将在今后的工作中调查这些问题。

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 summarizes one hybrid decoding iteration. The draft replay computes causal KV for the pending suffix while proposing a new block, and the runtime copies the pending-token KV rows into history. Hybrid decoding commits a sufficiently long confidence prefix; otherwise, an AR-causal verifier processes [ anchor , d 1 , … , d D ] [\text{anchor},d_{1},\ldots,d_{D}] at width D + 1 D{+}1 and determines the accepted prefix. Its additional token corrects the first rejected position or serves as a bonus after full acceptance. Confidence-only decoding uses the confidence branch, while speculative-only decoding always uses the verifier branch.
